about: What Domovoi's text-to-phoneme converter (domovoi/phonemizer) must produce. Generated by scripts/g2p/make_golden.py; asserted by domovoi/tests/test_phonemizer_golden.py and by the Kotlin port. Format: domovoi/phonemizer/README.md, 'The golden fixture'.

Each case: text -> phonemes (one string per sentence, the voice's symbols, UTF-8) -> ids (one list per sentence). Cases without 'pronunciations' use default_pronunciations; a case with 'pronunciations' replaces the list with exactly those entries ([] = none).
'dialect' names the phoneme set a case is written in (see 'dialects'); a case without one is in "en". Every text appears once per set.

'model' lists the words the out-of-dictionary model pronounced (ARPAbet), for debugging. 'near_tie' names model words whose choice is within near_tie_margin logits of another phoneme: exact on x86-64 ONNX Runtime, possibly one phoneme off on another runtime.

ids.rule: NFD-normalize the phoneme string; ids = map['^'] + map['_'], then for each code point in the map: map[c] + map['_'] (code points not in the map are skipped), then map['$'].
ids.dialects: the same map for both sets: Piper's espeak symbol map, which the en-us voices checked (2026-10-12) carry too
